cases.input: Implement one bounded vertical issue by first adding an executable acceptance test that fails, then the smallest end-to-end production change, followed by limited behavior-preserving refactoring and all relevant checks.
requiredBehaviors: record failing acceptance-oriented Red evidence before production changes
implement the smallest end-to-end path that makes the acceptance check Green
refactor only after Green and verify focused plus relevant regression checks
forbiddenBehaviors: weaken assertions or delete failing tests to obtain Green
expand into unrelated behavior or broad infrastructure work

cases.input: The behavior crosses an external service that cannot run in CI. Preserve one observable acceptance seam using a stable contract and deterministic local fake, and record remaining external verification.
requiredBehaviors: introduce the smallest stable contract and deterministic local fake
preserve an observable end-to-end acceptance seam
report external verification and residual uncertainty explicitly
forbiddenBehaviors: treat mock interaction alone as acceptance evidence
claim the unavailable external integration is fully verified

cases.input: The proposal starts with broad framework refactoring, writes production code before Red, weakens assertions, and marks Green without demonstrating the original acceptance criterion.
requiredBehaviors: restore a bounded acceptance-oriented Red-Green-Refactor cycle
require direct evidence for the original acceptance criterion
forbiddenBehaviors: declare Green from unrelated unit or mock-only tests
skillAnchors: Abnahmeevidenz muss das ursprüngliche Kriterium direkt belegen
